comment: Documented exceptions for the production npm-audit release gate (scripts/audit-gate.cjs). Each entry allowlists ONE advisory (by GHSA id) that is confirmed upstream-blocked: no direct dependency bump or npm override in THIS repo can remediate it. Any advisory NOT listed here still fails the gate at the moderate+ threshold. Every entry must carry the reason it is not remediable here, the condition that clears it, and the date it was reviewed. Re-verify entries at every release: remove an entry as soon as its upstream fix lands (the gate warns on stale entries that no longer match anything).

exceptions.reason: Vulnerable brace-expansion@5.0.7 is nested inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, whose published npm-shrinkwrap.json freezes its transitive tree; by npm design a shrinkwrap is authoritative, so a downstream override cannot replace it (verified empirically 2026-07-28: override left the nested copy at 5.0.7). Exposure is a DoS via unbounded expansion of glob patterns inside pi's own CLI internals — not attacker-controlled input in pi-research's usage.
exceptions.clearsWhen: pi-coding-agent publishes a release whose shrinkwrap pulls brace-expansion >=5.0.8 (fix already published upstream; satisfiable within pi's own ^5.0.5 range).

exceptions.reason: sharp <0.35.0 (libvips CVEs) is a direct dependency of @huggingface/transformers, which pi-research uses exclusively for TEXT embeddings (knowledge store); the sharp image-processing pipeline is never invoked, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable in this package. Forcing sharp 0.35 via an override would deviate a native module from the upstream-tested combination on a code path our test suite cannot exercise — higher regression risk than the unreachable advisory.
exceptions.clearsWhen: @huggingface/transformers publishes a release depending on sharp >=0.35.0 (transformers is deliberately pinned at 4.2.x in this repo; re-evaluate at the next planned transformers bump).
